This section is appended by C4 (`docs/plans/2026-09-10-claude-klabauter-noun-sweep-across-the-tree.md`),
not by `classify-legacy-engine-noun-references.py` — the generator's own counts and tables above
are untouched. It is exempt from the "do not hand-edit" banner at the top of this file because it
records a disposition decision the generator does not compute, not a re-derivation of its scan.

**Dead fake deleted.** `coordinator/tests/_fake_claude_klabauter_identity.py` (the `RealIdentityCheckMixin`
stand-in) is deleted: nothing imported it or its only class, and its own docstring said no test
wired the mixin in. Its two lines that appeared in this manifest's `CONTRACT-BOUND` table above
(`coordinator/tests/_fake_claude_klabauter_identity.py:1` and `:23`) are gone with the file; the manifest's
own generated per-class counts above are a SHA-pinned snapshot (see § Generator performance) and
are not retroactively decremented by this deletion, per that section's own note that this
generator is shipped as a one-time snapshot, not a re-runnable-under-budget artifact.
